Standard: Hydraulic and pneumatic systems utilize either previously qualified lines (tubing and hoses) and fittings from a QPL (maintained by DoW or industry) or new materials are fully qualified. Tubing is designed and qualified IAW SAE AS5440B, Tubing Material paragraph. Fittings are designed and qualified IAW SAE AS5440B, Fittings and Boss Fittings paragraphs. Hoses are designed and qualified IAW SAE AS5440B, Hose Assemblies paragraph. Proof and burst pressure for lines and complete system(s) are tested to the values IAW SAE AS5440B, Pressure Limitations paragraph. Impulse testing is conducted IAW SAE AS603B. Flexure testing is conducted IAW SAE ARP1185C. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Inspect drawings and documentation to verify lines and fittings (including repair fittings) are from a QPL. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing of any tubing, hoses, and fittings not on a QPL to verify they meet all required qualification tests.
  (2) Ground test: Conduct on air vehicle proof pressure test on complete hydraulic system(s) to verify proper installation of tubing, hoses, and fittings and that leaks are within limits.
